source.citation: Radtke-Schuller S, Schuller G, Angenstein F, Grosser OS, Goldschmidt J, Budinger E (2016). Brain atlas of the Mongolian gerbil (Meriones unguiculatus) in CT/MRI-aided stereotaxic coordinates. Brain Struct Funct 221(Suppl 1):1-272.
source.note: Structure/plate assignments taken verbatim from the authors' published Index of structures. Plate AP coordinates derived from the linear stereotaxic series printed on each plate (bregma 7.80 mm at plate 1, 350 um steps) and verified by OCR of all 62 plates.

conventions.plane: coronal (frontal), perpendicular to the brainstem axis
conventions.ap_zero: bregma (also given for lambda, interaural line, occipital crest)
conventions.ap_sign: positive = anterior to the landmark; plate 1 is the most anterior
conventions.dv_zero: plane through the most dorsal points of cerebrum and cerebellum; negative is ventral

verification.method: Every plate was rendered at 300 dpi; black label text was isolated by colour (labels are black, contours red, tissue pale blue) and OCR'd with Tesseract. Recognised tokens were matched to the 723 published abbreviations with a confusion-tolerant key (l/I/1, O/0, S/5).
verification.note: OCR located and confirmed 2532 of 3506 index entries (4164 individual printed labels, since most appear once per hemisphere). The shortfall is expected: a structure listed for a plate range is not necessarily labelled on every plate of that range, and small 1-2 character abbreviations are often missed. No systematic contradiction of the published index was found; residual OCR-only tokens were dominated by known letter confusions (CA1->CAT, PFl->PIF, GlA->GiA, EPl->IPl, PaS->Pa5, Me5->me5) confirmed by visual inspection. AngT was visually confirmed as printed on plate 29 although the published index lists only plate 28.

known_source_discrepancies.observed: label also printed on plate 29 (visually confirmed)

verification.coordinates: Plate AP coordinates were OCR'd from all 62 plates and matched the analytic series (bregma 7.80 mm at plate 1, -0.35 mm per plate; lambda = bregma+4.45; interaural = bregma+7.25; occipital crest = bregma+9.95) exactly, with one OCR sign error on plate 34 corrected against the model.
verification.plate_registration: Plates were cropped relative to the printed coordinate frame, detected per page, rather than to fixed page fractions. In the source PDF the plate 31 figure sits 118 px (300 dpi) lower on the page than every other plate, and plates 1 and 10 are offset by 2-3 px; frame-relative cropping removes these offsets so all 62 plate images share one coordinate frame.

label_positions.note: Screen positions of the printed abbreviation labels on each plate, located by OCR. Keyed by plate, then abbreviation; each entry is a list of [cx, cy, w, h] fractions of the frame-cropped plate image (labels usually appear twice, once per hemisphere).
